September 9, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-9-1971-54682

World Peace Council’s Indian delegate Krishna Menon at a special UN committee meeting urges the committee to intervene into the Bengalis’ liberation movement as he thinks Bangladesh is facing a colonial condition.

Mukti Bahini killed 45 Pak troops and wounded 15 others at Shashiali, Panchhara in Gazipur, Jambari and Kutishwar, a war bulletin published by the PR department of Bangladesh Force HQ says.

East Pakistan Jamaat Ameer Ghulam Azam demands to add a few more people in the Pakistani envoy team for UNGA. The people are: Hamidul Haque Chowdhury, Moulvi Farid Ahmad, Justice Hamoodur Rahman, Dr Syed Sazzad Hossain, AQM Shafikul Islam, Barrister Akhter Uddin, Abdus Sabur and Fazlul Quader Chowdhury.
